list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Triple-decker sandwich tetranuclear europium(II) complex with coupled indenyl ligands

source_locations.location: Supporting Information Available statement in main article
Results and Discussion, structural discussion of 3; Figure 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A centrosymmetric Eu4 complex comprising two side-by-side triple-decker sandwiches. Coupled indenyl ligands connect the sandwiches, while bridging chlorides link their europium centers into a ladder-like structure.

synthesis.procedure: Under the reported air- and moisture-sensitive Schlenk conditions, a toluene solution of indene compound 1 was added slowly to a toluene solution of [(Me3Si)2N]3Eu(μ-Cl)Li(THF)3. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 6 h and then refluxed for 12 h.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature, then reflux in toluene; crystallization at 0 °C
synthesis.time: 6 h at room temperature, then 12 h at reflux
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The solvent was evaporated under reduced pressure, and the residue was washed with 8.0 mL n-hexane. The solid was extracted with toluene (2 × 10 mL); the combined extract was concentrated to 15 mL, a drop of benzene was added, and orange-red crystals were obtained by cooling to 0 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A monomeric Eu(II) center coordinated by two indenyl ligands and the two nitrogen atoms of their pendant substituents.

synthesis.procedure: Europium(III) amide precursor was reacted with indene compound 2 using a procedure reported as similar to that for 3: addition in toluene, stirring at room temperature, followed by reflux and workup. The article also reports that conducting the reaction at 60 °C produced 4.
synthesis.time: Procedure stated to be similar to that for 3 (6 h at room temperature, then 12 h at reflux)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Prepared as yellow crystals following procedures stated to be similar to those used for 3; compound-specific crystallization details are not given.

title: Homolysis of the Eu-N Bond. Synthesis, Structural Characterization, and Catalytic Activity of Novel Europium(II) Complexes
